steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Why are there so many Reunion members here?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaargh!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Am I the only one who thinks that there are more and more of them coming?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Ugh!!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nope. It's clear that they have more reinforcements coming.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Curses... We still haven't had a chance to avenge them yet...!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: They ended up finding us first.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka, look.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Over by the east exit, I think those are Reunion's casters hiding over there.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: A lot of them approaching from the central passage as well as from the high-rises to our sides...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...They're trying to sneak over while pretending like they haven't noticed us yet.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But, we're on top of the roof...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: No matter how many they send at us, they'll be doomed if they get knocked over...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I feel like they're insulting my intelligence by launching an attack as brazen as this...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is Reunion launching their offensive?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All operators, regroup!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Wait, I think I just saw...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Isn't that the Reunion commander we ran into earlier?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ... Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: Did you turn her over to Lungmen?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Franka, we have to hold back the Reunion forces first!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (We'll have to make our way down once they're too afraid to keep attacking us!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (We'll have to spread out the battlefield for now!)

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: (Understood. We'll be doing a hit and run then!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What does it have to do with you?

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: ...How dare you!

steps.name: Skullshatterer
steps.text: My comrades, attaaack!
